subject: Awaiting goods receipt before payment - PO-00104
body:
Hello, invoice GG-2208 for EUR 340.00 has arrived against PO-00104 for August grounds maintenance, but we have no goods-received record on file for this order yet. We will release payment as soon as the work is confirmed complete on our side - no action needed from you unless the work has not started. Thank you.

Accounts Payable, Hotel Aurora
